_comment: The short question form on the home page. A second Netlify form alongside event-inquiry on the private events page — the two must keep different `name` values or submissions land in the wrong bucket. `badgeValue`/`badgeLabel` is a promise to visitors: leave it empty to hide the badge rather than claim a response time you cannot keep.

_photoFocus_comment: Where to centre the 4:5 crop. The frame is landscape and the slot is portrait, so about half the width is discarded; she stands at ~45% of the source, and a plain centre crop left her off to one side. Belongs with the photo — change one, re-check the other.
